item: Five fixes from the simulated-journalist walk: map click outline and docked card, chart zoom hint and whole-number count ticks, Timescale undo and overlay notes, Observatory resize and Theme select, Home signal value formatting
status: shipped (browser-checked in headless Chromium; human pass pending)
summary: Map: a clicked country is outlined (oomap-sel, non-scaling stroke) and its card docks under the map with a close button, restored after a repaint. Charts: idle readout names the zoom gestures; a small integer count axis gets whole-number ticks that divide the range (0-4 no longer 0,1,3,4). Timescale relabelled Snap range to, Day restores the pre-snap range. Overlay keeps its select, announces the automatic Indexed switch and puts the no-price note under the chart. Observatory follows its stage width (LESSON: a hidden tab measures 0 wide, and a px-sized canvas in a shrink-to-fit parent feeds back into the parent min-content, so measure inner clientWidth and give the parent contain:inline-size). Settings Theme select applies on change. Home signal values go through the shared formatter (0.409, not 0.4090909090909091). Left out for rulings: map country names and scale bar, 25x zoom limit, border-file load time, palette Enter new tab (Q608), Explore filter row at 390 px.
